description:
DriverLog is the simplest to operate, most complete and most versatile electronic Hours Of Service solution.
DriverLog is both a mobile app that can be installed on any Android device, and is an integrated Fleet management application (can be integrated into 3rd party solutions or our Wireless Links Fleet.Net)

On the server side, DriverLog provides the dispatcher with complete visibility of the status of every driver in the HOS shift and cycle including replay of daily history and comprehensive reports.

To meet different customer requirements and specific system configurations to send data from the ECM to the ELD and then to upload and synchronize the ELD with the server, Driver Log is packaged with multiple hardware solutions that plug into the vehicle ECM and sends the J1939 and J1708 protocols to the ELD via Bluetooth or WIFI, learn more by clicking this link http://www.wlius.com/hos

This is a partial list of the DriverLog functionalities :
• Automatically calculates and displays current and available driving and on duty time in drivers’ shift and cycle.
• Allows review of six months of day-by-day history.
• Allows editing logs (while recording the edit)
• Alerts the driver of upcoming shift and/or cycle time violations
• Fully integrated with DVIR.
• Automatic driving and stop status detection.
• Automatically uploads to the server via cellular or WIFI every event in real time, so the dispatcher has a complete real time visibility of the drivers’ status within the HOS shift and cycle.
• No data can be lost – the data on the Android device synchronizes real time with the server and is being backed up on the server. In case that the Android device is broken or lost, the driver’s data is downloaded from the server automatically to the new Android device.
• The identical logs displayed on the driver’s Android device are also displayed and printable on the management console.
• DriverLog is fully integrated with Wireless Links Fleet.Net GPS based fleet management system or if you already have a fleet management system DriverLog can be an independent standalone system.
• For integrators DriverLog can be fully integrated into any 3rd party fleet management and/or dispatch application.
• DriverLog has the option to send real time GPS data to a fleet management system, saving the need for a separate GPS unit

Make Your life easier by using this app to track trips for personal, business, reimbursement or tax deduction purposes. It's easy to use and makes most of work for you.

TRIPS
* Create trips using GPS tracking. App automatically determines trip distance, travel time, start and end addresses.
* Driving route on the map.
* Dashboard: current speed, elapsed time and distance.
* Create trip entries manually: You can use template trip, copy an existing trip or enter manually all data.
* Add notes to the trips.

AUTOMATIC RECORDING
* Automatic trip start, pause and resume on bluetooth device connect/disconnect events.

LOGBOOK
* Filterable logbook: Filter by vehicle, trip type, trip reason or by predefined/manually defined trip periods.
* Grouping: Group logbook entries by day, week or month. Groups can be expanded/collapsed.
* Automatic determination of gaps between trips.

REPORTS
* Supported formats: PDF, XLS and CSV.
* Designed reports which includes company, driver, car and trips data
* Include reimbursement or fringe benefit amounts to reports
* Choose report period by predefined or manually picked ranges
Note: To use reports functionality You have to make in-app subscription (1 payment per 6 months). But before purchasing, the app offers to see sample reports so You can see if the reports suits for You.

APP PERMISSIONS
* Location: for using GPS.
* Full network access: for getting trip addresses automatically.
* Read/Modify the contents of SD card: for database backup.
* Bluetooth: for automatic recording on bluetooth connect/disconnect events.

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES
* English
* Estonian

name: BigRoad ELD
description:
BigRoad ELD is an easy-to-use electronic logging device certified with FMCSA and 3rd Party Certified in Canada. Use it as part of the Unity Suite of software products to run your entire business smoothly and efficiently. BigRoad ELD is great for all sizes of fleets from owner operators to large multi-carrier organizations! Easily track your hours-of-service and create ELD compliant logs by connecting to one of our ELD devices.

EASY, EFFORTLESS ELECTRONIC LOGS
Track your Hours of Service with a few taps. US and Canadian rule sets supported. Easily edit logs according to the regulations.

STOP GUESSING. START DRIVING.
See how much drive time you have left with a quick glance. No more estimating and guessing – BigRoad ELD calculates your remaining time for you. Receive notifications as you approach the end of your drive, shift, and cycle to make sure you don’t go over.

AVOID ERRORS. PREVENT FINES
Proactive notification of errors and violations help you run in compliance to avoid costly fines and out-of-service time. Correct errors before they’re caught during an inspection.

SAY GOODBYE TO PAPERWORK AND FAXES
Easily send your fleet manager your logs and vehicle inspection reports. Capture and send supporting documents within the app. Record fuel purchase receipts in the app and they’ll be sent directly to the office. Stop worrying about keeping track of all those slips of paper.

BREEZE THROUGH INSPECTIONS
Displays a clean, easy-to-read, compliant ELD log, on-screen, for inspectors to review. Stores logs and supporting documents in one location. Display, print, email, or fax driver logs. Easily send to safety officials using supported methods when requested.

STAY CONNECTED
Use the simple in-app chat to keep your manager updated and connect with other drivers in your fleet. Capture and store documents and photos with your device’s camera and send them to the office from right in the app.

SUPPORTS REGULATIONS THROUGHOUT THE US AND CANADA
•Supports US FMCSA, DOT, and Canadian HOS rules. Specify property or passenger carrying rules, short-haul, oil field, and state rules for Alaska, California, and Texas.

QUICK AND EASY DVIRS
Create compliant DVIRs with just a few taps.


The BigRoad ELD Mobile App is compatible with current FMCSA, DOT, and Transport Canada rules and regulations. Pair it with one of our certified ELD hardware devices to comply with the ELD mandate.

Learn more at www.bigroad.com and www.fleetcomplete.com

IMPORTANT NOTES
We recommend keeping your phone or tablet plugged into a charger for the best GPS coverage. If the battery is low, the app will check GPS location less often. The BigRoad app asks for access to your contacts and phone so you can easily send check-in messages, documents, and copies of your log using your contact manager. We do not copy or store any of your contact information.

name: Logbook.aero - Pilot Logbook
description:
Pilot Logbook - the mobile app for www.logbook.aero



Logbook.aero is an advanced electronic logbook solution for all pilots: Airline, commercial, instructor, general aviation and students. With multiplatform access, including our mobile app and website: www.logbook.aero.

The easiest way to log your flights:
Log all of your flight data with Logbook.aero - aircraft, airfields, flight times, approaches, crew, passengers.
ADS-B Lookup for quick flight entry, and attach the ADS-B flight track to flights.
Auto-night calculation for accurate entries.
Live record your flight from the app - auto-airfield detection, flight time calculation, GPS log creation and adding the flight to your logbook.
Electronic signatures - your instructor/examiner can endorse flight entries.
Add GPS tracks, documents, comments and photos to your pilot logbook entries.
Offline mode - log and view your logbook flights in-flight without internet access.

Airline Import:
Import your flights to your pilot logbook from over 150 airlines, scheduling systems, flying schools and other digital pilot logbooks. The quickest, most accurate way to log your flights.
AIMS eCrew (Easyjet, WizzAir, Aer Lingus, Eithad, Virgin Atlantic and many more), Netline Crewlink (Lufthansa and more), NavBlue RAIDO, Ryanair EFB email, Emirates, Jet2, Qantas, Virgin Australia, American, United, Delta, Soutwehst, Cathay Pacific, Qatar, Flightlogger and lots more.

Pilot Logbook Reports:
With multiple reports in the app and more on the website , you can analyse your flying history with ease. Flight times, airfields visited, routes, aircraft flown, approaches and people you have flown with - all at the touch of button.

PDF Export:
Export a PDF of your pilot logbook for licence applications, examinations, job applications. Available in EASA FCL.050, FAA, UK PPL, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, South Africa formats.

Licences tracking:
Add your licences, ratings, currencies and medicals to Logbook.aero. Track your licences immediately, and receive automatic notifications in advance of expirations.

Secure cloud storage:
All of your logbook data is stored in the cloud, and available instantly across your devices (mobile, tablet, browser) without any need for synching. Auto-backup your logbook data to Dropbox, Google Drive or by email (available via the website - coming soon to the app).

Live Flight Creation
Record your flight live in-flight to generate a GPS track and automatically add flight entry into your logbook. This uses the location and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION permissions (only used for this feature).

name: Trucker Guide: Truck GPS Maps
description:
Trucker Guide is a commercial truck GPS navigation app trusted by 500,000+ CDL drivers — with semi truck routing, low clearance alerts, real-time weigh station status, Walmart overnight parking, fuel prices, and 450,000+ trucker-friendly locations across the USA and Canada.

Trucker Guide – the all-in-one trucking GPS navigation tool developed specifically for commercial drivers. Whether you're hauling OTR or making local deliveries, Trucker Guide ensures you have the safest and most efficient routes ahead. Our truck-specific GPS navigation saves you time and money on every haul.

TRUCK-SAFE GPS NAVIGATION
Get routes specifically calculated for your truck height, width, weight, and cargo type. Unlike Google Maps, Trucker Guide prioritizes truck-relevant routing rules — not standard passenger vehicle logic. Route planning for trucks includes weight limit routing, low clearance bridges, weight-restricted roads, No Truck zones, and sharp turns. Turn-by-turn navigation with voice guidance, offline maps, and toll cost estimates — built for semi trucks and commercial vehicles. Navigation stays active in the background so you can switch between ELD systems, dispatch tools, or logging apps without losing your route.

RELIABLE ON LONG-HAUL ROUTES
Navigation maintains consistent guidance even when signal strength drops — across rural roads, remote highways, and areas with limited connectivity. No interruptions, no reloads. The route continues until you arrive.

LOW CLEARANCE ALERTS
Avoid accidents, cargo damage, and costly delays with up-to-date low clearance information. Trucker Guide ensures your semi truck fits safely under bridges and through tunnels across the US and Canada.

WEIGH STATION STATUS
Stay ahead of DOT inspections with real-time weigh station open/closed status. Know instantly which stations are active along your route, check status history, and find CAT Scales nearby. Get recommendations for HOS rest stops to keep your Hours of Service compliant.

WALMART OVERNIGHT PARKING
Find Walmart locations with truck parking, check open/closed status in real time, view satellite layout of entrances and exits, and build a truck-safe route directly from the app.

REAL-TIME PARKING AVAILABILITY
Check live parking availability at truck stops, rest areas, and public parking near you or along your route. See which spots are open before you arrive — no more wasted detours.

FUEL PRICES & DIESEL SAVINGS
Find the cheapest diesel prices along your route across the USA and Canada. Compare fuel prices at Pilot Flying J, Love's, Petro, TA, and thousands of independent diesel stations and truck stops before you pull in.

TRAFFIC CAMERAS & ROAD CONDITIONS
Access over 11,000 live traffic and DOT cameras for real-time traffic updates for trucks. Check highway cameras before you drive — see accidents, construction, and weather conditions along your route.

450,000+ TRUCKER-FRIENDLY LOCATIONS
Over 450,000 truck stop locations and points of interest with real truck driver reviews: rest areas, weigh stations, Walmart locations, hotels with truck parking, truck washes, repair shops, tire shops, roadside assistance, CDL-friendly fuel stations, scales, oil & lube, truck dealers, trailer dealers, and more — all verified for commercial vehicles.

name: TruckBooks: Trucker Expenses
description:
TruckBooks is the expense tracker built for owner-operator truck drivers.

Capture fuel, tolls, repairs, truck supplies, receipts and per diem in seconds, right when they happen. No backlog. No shoebox of faded receipts. No tax-season guessing.

BUILT FOR THE CAB

TruckBooks is made for life on the road, not a desk. Add an expense by voice, photo, or manual entry while you're parked, fueling, or waiting at a stop.

VOICE, PHOTO, OR TYPE

Say an expense out loud, snap a receipt, or enter it by hand. TruckBooks helps you record the amount, date, vendor and category before you forget.

TRUCKING EXPENSE CATEGORIES

Organize common owner-operator expenses like:

- Fuel and DEF
- Repairs and parts
- Maintenance and tires
- Parking and tolls
- Insurance
- Truck supplies
- Phone and communications
- Shower, laundry and travel expenses
- Business and admin costs

PER DIEM TRACKING

Mark full, partial, and home days on a simple calendar. TruckBooks helps you track transportation-worker per diem records throughout the year instead of reconstructing them from memory at tax time.

SCHEDULE C-READY REPORTS

Export clean PDF or CSV reports for your records or your accountant. Keep expense totals, per diem summaries, receipt photos and category breakdowns organized before tax season.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL

TruckBooks saves expenses, voice notes, receipt photos and per diem days on your phone first. No signal means no interruption to your workflow.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your business records are yours. TruckBooks is built with local-first storage, privacy-conscious sync, and no advertising model.

MADE FOR OWNER-OPERATORS

Generic bookkeeping apps assume you are sitting at a desk. TruckBooks is built for truckers who need to capture expenses quickly, keep cleaner records, and stay focused on the road.

TruckBooks is a record-keeping tool, not tax, legal, accounting, or financial advice. Always review deductions, per diem calculations, and reports with your CPA or qualified tax professional before filing.

Smart route planning and navigation, 3D offline maps, realtime traffic and precise ETA, speed cameras warnings and an easy-to-use interface provide an effective sat nav experience.

The app offers navigation specially tailored to specifications of: truck / HGV / RV / caravan / motorhome / camper / van / bus / car/ or car with trailer.

1. Customized routes for vehicle type, size & weight
Enter your vehicle type, size, weight, number of trailers & other settings. The app calculates the route according to set parameters and prevents run-ins with hazards like low bridges or narrow streets.

2. Advanced vehicle settings (including HAZMAT)
Set your load settings (general HAZMAT, water pollutants, explosives) and navigate on eligible and safe roads only. Set preferences such as right turns, avoidance of toll roads & ferries, or arrival with the destination on the right side.

3. 3D offline maps (no internet needed) with free map updates
Never get lost waiting for a signal again. Offline maps guarantee you'll always find anything you need – even without an internet connection. They come in handy when driving abroad or in areas with poor signal coverage. We update the map data multiple times per year.

4. Realtime traffic & Speed cameras
Add Realtime traffic to avoid delays on the road, have precise ETA information, and deliver on time. Speed cameras warn you when a mobile or fixed speed cameras are on your route. Head-Up display (HUD) projects optimized navigation instructions onto the car's windshield.

5. Thousands of truck / caravan related POIs
Navigate to thousands of reliable and detailed points of interest (POIs) from trusted sources, such as truck stops, weight stations, parking lots, campsites, hotels, restaurants, etc. Fill up at the best price with realtime information about fuel prices along your route.

6. Truck & caravan specific Speed limits & alerts
The sat nav app shows the current speed, the maximum allowed speed, and upcoming speed limit changes. You will get clear visual and sound alerts when you exceed the speed limit.

7. Dynamic lane assistant & Clear voice instruction
The sat nav app will guide you into the correct lane and show you the junction with highlighted lanes and exits. Voice navigation with clear & accurate driving instructions helps focus on the road ahead and frees you from checking the route on a phone display.

8. Multistop route planning & Optimization
Plan your trip and set up routes with up to 150 waypoints. Easily customize the waypoint order or choose the option "Optimize." The app will rearrange the waypoints to achieve the best efficiency.

9. Plan with Google Maps & send the route to the app (Android only)
With Sygic Truck Route Sender – a cost-free extension available in Chrome and Firefox - you can plan your route with Google Maps with up to 10 stops on your desktop. Then send the route directly to the app.

Rely on Sygic GPS Truck & Caravan Navigation, the best copilot on your routes and the most advanced sat nav on the market!

name: Drive Hours – Learner Log
description:
Drive Hours – Your Smart Driving Lessons Companion

Drive Hours is a clean and intuitive application created for learner drivers who want to track their driving lessons and monitor progress toward obtaining a driver’s license. The app allows you to log every driving session, keep track of completed hours, and clearly see how close you are to reaching your goal. All information is presented in a simple and readable way, helping you stay organized throughout your driving course.

The application focuses on progress tracking through clear visual indicators and real-time statistics. You can monitor completed driving hours, view remaining time until course completion, and set custom hour requirements for different driving license categories such as B, C, or D. This flexibility makes Drive Hours suitable for various learning paths and individual requirements.

Managing driving sessions is fast and straightforward. Each session can be added using an intuitive date and time picker, allowing you to record both hours and minutes accurately. The full history of driving sessions is always available, and previously saved entries can be edited or deleted if changes are needed. Sessions can also be categorized by license type, making it easy to stay organized even when tracking multiple courses.

Drive Hours provides helpful insights into your driving habits. Weekly activity overviews and calculated averages help you understand your learning patterns and consistency. The app also estimates how many days remain until completion based on your activity, allowing you to plan your lessons more effectively and maintain steady progress.

To keep you motivated, Drive Hours includes an achievement system that rewards progress throughout your course. Milestones such as the first recorded hour, halfway completion, and final achievement help visualize success and encourage regular practice. Achievements are dynamically adapted to your selected license category, giving you a clear sense of advancement.

The design of Drive Hours emphasizes simplicity and modern usability. The interface follows Material Design principles, offering smooth animations, intuitive navigation, and an edge-to-edge layout for an immersive experience. The app supports light mode, dark mode, and system-based themes, ensuring comfortable use in any environment. Its responsive layout adapts well to different screen sizes while remaining easy to use.

The app automatically detects your system language, and you can also change the language manually in the settings at any time. This makes the application accessible to a broader range of users without additional configuration.

Drive Hours is designed for learner drivers preparing for their driving test, students tracking mandatory driving hours, instructors helping learners stay organized, and anyone who wants a clear overview of their driving practice. Unlike complicated tracking tools, Drive Hours focuses on clarity, elegance, and ease of use, making it effortless to log sessions and understand progress at a glance.

Getting started is simple. Choose your driving license category, set your required number of hours, and begin adding driving sessions. As you continue, you can watch your progress grow and unlock achievements along the way.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvement, support is available through the app settings or by leaving feedback on Google Play.

Download Drive Hours today and take full control of your driving lessons and learning progress.

Job Flexibility at Your Fingertips

Ready to shine bright and make your future spark? Whether you’re looking for per diem, short-term, long-term, or permanent work in the medical field, ShiftMed puts incredible power at your fingertips, letting you choose the shifts that fit your style, all while earning those dollar bills with a smile.

Through our app, you can easily access a variety of open shifts at various healthcare facilities in your community, from long-term care locations to nursing homes to hospitals. When building your work schedule precisely how you want it, our app has all the tools you need to succeed.

You can filter your shift feed based on your preferred start time, driving distance, hourly rate, and favorite healthcare facility. Talk about personalized perfection! We also don’t believe in shift minimums—work 8 hours one week and 40 the next. And unless you’re looking to make some sweet holiday pay, mandatory holidays, overtime, and weekends are no longer a thing.

Work Benefits You Deserve

As a ShiftMed nurse, you can access benefits that will make your heart sing and your career soar. We’ve got an entire lineup of perks that include competitive pay, holiday rates, bonus incentives, affordable healthcare plans, and exclusive in-app features.

· Guaranteed Shifts®: Get paid for the entire shift if the facility cancels or sends you home early. So, there’s no need to stack your schedule with overlapping shifts because you’re worried a facility might cancel—the only shift you need to claim is a guaranteed one.

· ShiftMed Instant Pay™: Request up to 75% of your pre-taxes earnings immediately after clocking out of a shift. Submit the desired amount, and we’ll deposit the funds directly into your bank account with ZERO transaction fees.

· Next Day Pay®: If your bank doesn’t support Instant Pay ACH transfers, you can still get paid before Friday using our free Next Day Pay service. Request to receive up to 75% of your pre-tax earnings, and we’ll deposit your pay directly into your bank account the next business day.

· Uber Health Rides: Never again will car problems slow you down. Our exclusive partnership with Uber Health allows you to request rides to and from your shifts directly in our app.

· Hooray Health: Access quality, affordable health insurance benefits for you and your family after working just one shift. Plan offerings include medical options, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance.

· Platinum Rewards Program: We reward you big time for showing up for shifts, from entry into monthly sweepstakes to first dibs on holiday pay rates. And the higher your show rate, the better your shift-claiming experience gets.

· W-2 Employment Status: When you work with ShiftMed, you’re a W-2 employee—not a 1099 independent contractor. Being a W-2 employee is loaded with benefits, such as paying less in FICA payroll taxes, being eligible for company benefits, and so much more!

Connect With Us

Learn more about working with us as a CNA, GNA, STNA, LVN, LPN, or RN by visiting ShiftMed.com or giving us a shout at (800) 485-9002. Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter, and LinkedIn for our latest updates.

description:
Work Log is a quick, easy and free way to keep track of your shifts and calculate the number of hours worked and wages earned over your pay period.

• Use the Premium/Differential Hours feature to automatically track premium rates during any times like weekends or evenings

• Use the notes section to keep track of detailed notes

• Automatic cloud backups and syncing between devices (logging in is required in to use these features)

• Upgrade to Work Log Pro to remove ads, add unlimited new jobs, and export your records

Work Log - Shift Tracker vs Work Log:
Work Log was originally created for Android in 2013 and has been continuously added to and improved since then. In 2023 Work Log - Shift Tracker was created from scratch. Creating a new app from scratch made it possible to add many features users have been requesting over the years, such as automatic cloud backups and syncing, and per shift wages.

In order to support the long term continued development of the improvement of all Work Log products and to cover the ongoing cost of cloud backups and syncing, the new business model is a subscription model. The original Work Log will not be going away, and you can continue to use it indefinitely.

name: Shift Tracker : Work Calendar
description:
Shift Tracker is a clean shift calendar, work schedule planner and earnings tracker for people who work rotating, irregular, day or night shifts.

Create your schedule in seconds, see your next shift at a glance, track working hours and estimated pay, plan days off and vacations, and keep your work pattern organised in one app. No account is required, and your core schedule data is stored locally on your device.

Plan any shift pattern

Choose a ready-made rotation or create a custom repeating work cycle that matches your schedule. Use patterns such as 2 work / 2 off, 3 work / 3 off, 4 work / 4 off, or 2 day shifts / 2 night shifts / 4 days off.

Need something different? Build your own cycle with day shifts, night shifts and days off. Set the start date once and the calendar repeats the pattern automatically.

Shift calendar at a glance

Use the monthly calendar to quickly see when you work and when you are free. Day shifts, night shifts, days off and vacations are clearly marked, making it easier to plan appointments, trips and personal time.

Open any date to add, edit or replace a shift without changing the rest of your repeating pattern.

Know what comes next

The Home screen shows:

• Today’s shift or day off
• Your next shift and start time
• Your next day off
• Your next planned vacation
• Upcoming shifts
• Monthly shifts, hours and estimated income

Track hours and estimated earnings

Add your hourly rate and shift settings to calculate estimated monthly earnings from your planned schedule.

See:

• Worked hours
• Remaining scheduled hours
• Total planned hours
• Day and night shift totals
• Days off
• Estimated monthly income
• Night, weekend and overtime calculations when configured

All earnings are estimates based on the information you enter and may differ from your official payslip.

Plan vacations

Add a vacation date range and see it directly in the calendar. Vacation days temporarily replace visible shifts without deleting the underlying repeating schedule. Edit or remove the vacation and the original shifts return automatically.

Shift reminders

Enable notifications for upcoming shifts and receive reminders before work begins. Stay prepared for early starts, late shifts and changing work patterns.

Designed for shift workers

Useful for healthcare staff, emergency services, security teams, factory and warehouse workers, retail employees, hospitality teams, transport staff and anyone with a rotating work schedule.

Whether you follow a fixed rota, 4 on 4 off, alternating day and night shifts, or a custom cycle, the app helps you keep work and personal time in balance.

Private and simple

No account is required. Your shifts, rates, earnings, vacations and preferences are stored locally on your device. Core schedule features work without an internet connection.

Shift Tracker Pro

Upgrade to Pro to unlock:

• Weekly schedule overview
• Monthly statistics and schedule insights
• PDF schedule export
• Today home screen widget
• Ad-free experience

The Today widget lets you check your current shift, next shift or day off from your Android home screen without opening the app.

Why choose Shift Tracker?

• Modern dark and light themes
• Fast shift entry and editing
• Ready-made and custom shift patterns
• Clear day, night, off and vacation states
• Work hours and earnings tracking
• Upcoming shift reminders
• No account required

Shift Tracker brings your shift calendar, rotating work schedule, hours tracker, estimated pay and days off together in one place. Spend less time calculating your rota and more time knowing when you work, what you may earn and when your next free day begins.

name: Jolly Classroom
description:
Make Teaching Phonics & Grammar Easy with Jolly Classroom!
Jolly Classroom is a comprehensive, interactive classroom app designed to support teachers in delivering systematic phonemic awareness, spelling, grammar and punctuation lessons with ease. With over 150 structured lessons, engaging activities and built-in phonics assessments, this app ensures that students develop strong reading and writing skills in a fun and research-backed way.

A Complete Classroom Solution
Jolly Classroom provides a structured, step-by-step approach to teaching phonics, grammar and spelling. Aligned with the Science of Reading, the app focuses on building essential phonemic awareness, reading fluency and writing accuracy in a way that is engaging and easy to follow.

What is Jolly Phonics?
Jolly Phonics is a programme for teaching reading and writing. It is based on a systematic synthetic phonics approach and was developed by teachers Sue Lloyd and Sara Wernham. It is the first stage in teaching children to read and write using the 5 key skills. It focuses on direct, explicit instruction of phonemic awareness and phonics for both reading (decoding) and writing (encoding). Scientific research has consistently shown phonemic awareness to be essential for building strong reading, spelling and writing skills.

Why Choose Jolly Classroom?
1. Phonics Programme – Bring phonemic awareness to your school with interactive activities and clear instructions
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation – Course introducing complex concepts of English Grammar in a fun and easy way
3. Built-in Phonics Assessments – Includes Jolly Phonics assessments and phonics screening tests to track student progress
4. Teacher-Friendly – Simple school setup with customisable staff and student profiles
5. Multi-Sensory Learning – Animated guidance, blending & segmenting tools and audio support make learning engaging for all students
6. British & American English Options – Tailor your teaching experience to suit different curriculums

Key Features That Make Learning Effective
1. Phonics Lessons - Step-by-step systematic phonics instruction, including 72 tricky words, helping children learn to read and write confidently
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation - Develop core English skills with structured lessons designed for classroom success
3. Phonics Assessments - built-in phonics assessments that help a school track student progress and prepare effectively for the Phonics Screening Check
4. Interactive Activities - Fun animations and audio support for letter formation, blending and segmenting
5. Progress Tracking - Monitor individual and class performance

Who Is Jolly Classroom For?
1. School – A curriculum-aligned solution for developing reading and writing skills
2. Teachers – A powerful classroom resource for structured phonics and grammar instruction
3. Pupils – Designed for early learners to master phonics, spelling and grammar through interactive lessons
4. Homeschool – An excellent tool for homeschool parents teaching their children at home with a structured, easy-to-follow program

Jolly Classroom is also an excellent resource for English learners, providing a structured and engaging way to build phonemic awareness, reading fluency and English grammar proficiency. With its systematic approach to teaching letter sounds, blending and sentence formation, the app helps English as a Second Language (ESL) students develop confidence in reading and writing. The interactive lessons and audio-supported activities ensure that learners can hear correct pronunciation, practice spelling and improve their understanding of grammar and sentence structure in an accessible way. Whether in a school or a homeschool setting, Jolly Classroom makes mastering English grammar and phonics easy!

Transform Your Classroom Today!
Join thousands of educators using Jolly Classroom to teach phonics, spelling and grammar with confidence.

Download now and bring phonics lessons into your school!

name: Student Gradebook for Teachers
description:
Student Gradebook for Teachers is a secure, offline-first gradebook designed for educators, teachers, and instructors who need a reliable way to manage student records and calculate academic performance. Built to handle complex grading rules entirely on your device, this app streamlines classroom administrative workflows without requiring any internet connection.

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security
Your student data belongs to you. Student Gradebook for Teachers operates with zero network requirements and zero data collection. All rosters, classes, marks, and formulas are securely stored locally inside an encrypted sandbox database on your mobile device.

Local Backup
Export class lists or share data across devices using local JSON backups. All backup and share processes are executed locally using standard secure device framework protocols.

description:

Grade Corner is a member of the Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC) and is available for schools to endorse in Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont.

- School districts using Infinite Campus

A: Yes. Grade Corner is a companion app — it uses your existing gradebook credentials. If you don't know yours, ask your school administrator.

A: Sometimes. Grade Corner was built independently by a parent with two kids in DC Public Schools. We're working on more official endorsements — the current list lives on our website.

Iconic Visual Timer

Inclusive by Design

Flexible for Every Routine
Use it once or build structured sequences. Create presets for daily habits. Run multiple timers at once. Make routines visual and calm transitions.
Trusted in Schools, Homes & Workplaces

Created for real life. Trusted for decades. Download Time Timer today and feel the difference.

name: Visual Countdown Timer
description:
Is it a battle to get your child to do something quickly?

This visual countdown timer App was designed for my 2 year old son to help him get his reward chart star for getting dressed quickly.
Getting him dressed used to take forever with many stalling strategies being deployed. Now he runs upstairs asking for the "Countdown timer".

Watch as the timer runs from green to amber to red, helping the child understand that time is running out.

A fun picture is slowly revealed as the timer runs down and when the time is up the child is rewarded with an exciting sound and the picture spins.

Background image changes to match the time of day, so that your child is given subtle hints as to what time of day the task they are being asked relates to.

Choose from the many fun images with different sounds for each, or choose your own image for the timer to reveal from your photo library to really surprise your child.

Endless possible uses:
* Getting dressed
* Getting out the door (shoes and coats on)
* Tidying
* Brushing teeth
* Sharing toys

Turns daily struggles into fun time!

We were also pleased to be told that this visual countdown timer is also great for children and adults with ADHD and Autism.

Fully COPPA compliant (The Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act)

name: Happy Kids Timer Chores
description:
Make the back to school transition smooth and encourage children to be independent
Happy Kids Timer is a simple to use visual timer app for children which helps them complete their morning or bedtime chores easily and on schedule.
This chore app is totally operated by your child, who carries the mobile device to each area/room where the daily task needs to be carried out/completed. You should give this game a try, if your child or teenager deals with ADHD/autism or needs to improve time management or following your busy daily schedule.

Why kids will love chores
The app offers a totally new approach that guides your kids with animated chores through their morning or bedtime turning chores into a funny educational game. It utilizes a smart incentive daily program with awards and a printable certificate. You don’t need old-fashioned chore chart anymore!

Smooth back to school transition
Do you struggle every morning to have your children get ready to face a long day at school? With Happy Kids Visual Timer app bedtime doesn't have to be challenging either.
If the visual timer just helps get you through a few mornings, makes putting kids to bed an enjoyable experience, or make back to school transition easier our mission will have been accomplished, but our experience indicates children love it and will use it for months.

On Demand activity
Select just one chore from the list anytime without a need to go through the entire routine, e. g. brush your teeth after lunch, or go to the toilet to use the app as a potty training timer.

Morning routine
Contains 8 animated chores for kids that will learn them to: Make your bed, Brush your teeth and wash your hands, Get dressed, Brush you hair, Eat your breakfast, Pack your lunch box, Pack your bag, Put your shoes on

Bedtime routine
Contains 7 animated chores for kids that will learn them to: Tidy your room, Go to the toilet, Take a shower or bath, Put on your pajamas, Brush your teeth, Prepare your clothes for tomorrow, Read a book, turn the lights off and go to sleep

The app includes common morning and bedtime activities and great motivation features and help kids learn new habits.

Premium version
The basic version guides your child through the whole morning or bedtime routines with predefined settings. Please consider a premium version to unlock all the feature and make this motivational chore app more flexible. Children will have fun and get through their routines on time.

With the single in-app purchase you willbe able to:
– add 4 custom chores with your own activity picture for each routine or change chores order to better fit your home habits,
– change duration or minimal activity duration time to better motivate kid,
– remove countdown timer to reveal stress from kids with autism or ADHD,
– name the reward you want your child to receive,
– define target stars amount for kid to deserve an reward,
– email/print a certificate after kids collected a defined amount of stars,
– and more.

Visit us
We are an open parents' community, making sure our children use smart devices not just to play games. This visual timer app was made by parents and tested on our own preschool kids and toddlers.

Visit us on Twitter, Facebook or Instagram. Tell us your story, suggest improvements or learn new parenting tips.

name: Planit: Photo Planner
description:
In this free version, the Ephemeris feature is provided as an in-app purchase. After the purchase, it will be the same as the paid PlanIt Pro. Some screenshots listed here have Ephemeris features enabled. The free version can actually do a lot of things than you thought. It is a plan/marker file reader, a focal length estimator on the map, a DoF and panorama calculator and can even preview the aerial view for your drone. The Ephemeris feature is so highly integrated that it is hard for us to provide some of them in the free version and ask you to pay for the rest. You can see how many users give us a one-star rating simply because we didn't provide a trial. I think that's not fair. But as we said, although we didn't provide a trial, please feel free to purchase to try it. We can refund you at any time if you don't like it.

Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

description:
Utiful is the photo filing system Google forgot to build. As featured in The Wall Street Journal.

Are you frustrated that Google Photos mixes everything—and won't let you create real order?

The Google Photos app won’t let you truly organize your pictures. You create an album, add photos—and they still stay in the camera roll. You delete them from the camera roll, and they disappear from the album too.

That’s why we built Utiful.

Unlike Google Photos and other gallery apps, Utiful lets you:
• Move photos out of your camera roll and away from the Android Gallery—finally!
• Sort your photos into separate categories—work, hobbies, personal, and more.
• Keep utility photos like documents, receipts, and IDs out of your main gallery.
• Keep your main gallery clean and tidy.

How Utiful Works:
• Use Utiful to move photos out of your camera roll and save them to Utiful folders.
• The photos are removed from the camera roll but kept in your Utiful folders.

Utiful’s further unique features include:
• Save photos to Utiful folders straight from the Photos app and from the Gallery app.
• Take photos with the folder camera that save directly to the folder.
• Manually rearrange photos in a folder—just the way you like.
• Customize the icons of your photo folders with emoji symbols and colors.
• Keep your Utiful folders on internal storage or SD card.
• Protect your Utiful folders with a passcode lock or fingerprint.
• Import/export photo folders from/to your computer.

Who Uses Utiful:
• Professionals & freelancers keeping work photos separate from personal ones
• Contractors & service providers managing before/after project pictures
• Doctors & lawyers organizing reference photos, evidence, and case documentation
• Hobbyists & creatives storing inspiration, artwork, and craft ideas
• Everyday users organizing screenshots, receipts, IDs, and notes by category as well as reference pictures such as haircuts, clothes, fitness tracking, songs identified with Shazam etc.

Quick Start Guide:

name: Exposure Calculator
description:
Capture the Light, Forget the Math.

Ever find yourself staring at a waterfall, holding a 10-stop ND filter, and trying to divide 1/125 by "darkness" in your head? We’ve all been there.

Whether you’re shooting long-exposure seascapes or pushing film in a vintage Leica, Exposure Calculator handles the arithmetic so you can focus on the art. It’s the Swiss Army knife for your camera bag—minus the bulky metal and the risk of cutting your thumb.

The Full Creative Toolkit

• The Master Calculator: Swap Aperture, Shutter Speed, or ISO on the fly. Set any two, and we’ll tell you the third. It’s like magic, but with physics.
• The ND Stack-O-Matic: Stack up to 3 ND filters (up to 30 stops!) without breaking a sweat. Perfect for turning choppy waves into mist or making tourists disappear from busy streets.
• Bulb & Long Exposure: From 4 seconds to 24 hours. We’ve even included a built-in timer and alarm, so you can go grab a coffee while your sensor drinks in the light.
• Reciprocity Failure: Film photographers, we see you. Account for the quirks of your favorite emulsion with the optional compensation wheel.

Pro Tools for Precision

• ND Calibration: Not all filters are created equal. Calibrate yours for pinpoint accuracy.
• Reverse Search: Know the look you want but not the filter you need? Work backward to find the perfect ND value.
• EV Readout: Get the Exposure Value of your scene at a glance.
• Night Vision Protection: Don't ruin your rods and cones. Use the custom color night mode to keep your eyes adjusted to the dark.

Why You’ll Love It

• Extreme Ranges: From f/1.0 to f/360 and ISO 0.4 to 3.2M.
• Total Customization: Define your own increments (1, 1/2, or 1/3 stops).
• Presets: Save your go-to setups for instant access.
• Pure & Clean: No ads, no tracking, and no personal data collection.

Stop guessing. Start calculating. Your sensor (and your brain) will thank you.

name: Stage Metronome with Setlist
description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

SETLIST FOR YOUR WHOLE SET

Build a setlist before the gig and store each song's tempo, time signature, beat pattern, and accent beats together. On stage, tap a song and everything loads instantly — no sliders, no reconfiguring under pressure. Export the setlist as a file and your bandmates can import the same settings on their own devices in seconds.

A DISPLAY YOU CAN READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM

The beat number is large enough to read from behind a drum kit or across a stage. Full-screen mode shows only the beat number and beat lights — no controls, just a clear visual reference for the whole band. Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. description:

★ Learn to play in tune with sustained pitch history ★
Visualize how steadily you play or sing. As notes are held out, a white line draws how steady the pitch is. The straighter the line, the more consistent the pitch.

★ Improve your ear with tone and chord generator ★
Need a reference tone or chord? Use the tone and chord generator to play and sustain chords with various tone options. Choose from different temperaments to hear how they compare.

★ Keep tempo with an accurate and simple metronome ★
See the pulse with a visual metronome. View subdivision and current beat, with a large display and visual flash.

★ Record and share ★
Record your practice and performances. Add reverb for a professional sound. Share recordings through e-mail, SoundCloud, Dropbox and more.

★ Features ★

Tuner
• Large, colorful tuning indicator clearly shows when in tune (green fills the screen)
• Clear, visual tuner with note, octave, cents (+\-), and frequency (hz) display
• Tuning history to see how well you’re sustaining notes over time
• Especially suited for wind instruments and strings with note detection from Tuba to Piccolo (24hz to 15khz+)
• Horizontal and vertical tuning displays
• Adjustable A=440 reference tone
• Change between equal, just, pythagorean, and 18 other tuning temperaments

Tone and Chord Generator
• Chromatic Tone Generator with multiple tone options and sustain
• Play and sustain chords
• Auto Octave rounding for easy note access

Metronome
• Large number display with visual flash to see the downbeat, subdivision, and pulse
• Adjust tempo, beats per measure, and subdivision
• See tempo markings to quickly jump between standard tempos
• Tempo Tap (tap metronome center to set a tempo)
• Continues to play when screen is locked or in the background

Record
• Record and save unlimited recordings
• Share recordings through e-mail, SoundCloud, DropBox, and more

Other
• Highly accurate (1/100 of a cent) and responsive
• Transpose notes to any instrument
• Dark and light themes

Tunable is a great tuner and works especially well for tuning wind and string instruments such as:

• Guitar, Ukelele
• Piccolo, Flute
• Oboe, English Horn, Bassoon
• Eb, Bb/A Soprano Clarinet, Bass Clarinet
• Soprano, Alto, Tenor, and Baritone Saxophone
• Trumpet and Cornet
• French Horn
• Tenor and Bass Trombone
• Euphonium and Tuba
• Violin, Viola, Chello, and Bass
______________________

★ ★ ★ NOTE ★ ★ ★

The current version of Tunable for Android does NOT include practice stats (ie. practice score, note cents display, etc). The next version of Tunable for Android will take time to include these features.

★ ★ ★ PERMISSIONS ★ ★ ★

Tunable uses the Record Audio permission in order to listen and tune your instrument. Tunable also uses read and write access to your external storage in order to save and display recordings created within Tunable.

★ ★ ★ KNOWN ISSUES ★ ★ ★

On some devices, Google Assistant can interfere with the microphone. If the tuner does not appear to be working, try turning the "Ok Google" or "Google Assistant" settings "always-on" off to see if that solves the problem. This only applies to some devices and the device manufacturers are working on a solution.

This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements. This baby tracker app will help parents get through the wonder weeks.

With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications

✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

name: Breastfeeding Newborn tracker
description:
The simplest program to track breastfeeding, pumping, bottle feeding, solid food consumption, diapers, sleep schedule, height and weight, and more.

With the click of a button your feedings and baby care history will be stored in the app. You will have an easy-to-maintain history of your baby’s growth.

In the application, you can share baby's data with your partner, relatives, or nanny. Syncing data between multiple devices is available for free.

The birth of a baby is a miracle that fills your heart with joy! A mother’s life changes dramatically with the birth of her baby. It is so important for a mother and her newborn baby to establish a comfortable breastfeeding relationship. Moms need to keep track of which breast to offer her baby, how long the baby suckles at each breast, the number of times the baby breastfeeds each day, how many wet diapers and bowel movements the baby has, how long and frequently the baby sleeps, as well as the baby’s weight and growth. All of this information is important for the self-assessment of breastfeeding and for assessing the growth of the child. Having this information easily accessible will be extremely useful when visiting with your pediatrician or lactation consultant.

It is important to record all of this data. Do not rely on your memory, because even the most organized mothers are often lost in the sea of information about their newborn.

Use the features of the Breastfeeding application.

Breastfeeding and pumping:
- record the time and quantity of feedings and / or pumpings;
- note which breast was fed or pumped last to ensure starting new feeding/pumping on the opposite breast;
- record the duration of feeding / pumping;
- pause feeding / pumping, if necessary;
- brief feedings / pumpings, or those that occur within a short period of time, are grouped into one feeding / pumping event
- quickly add feeding / pumping session that was similar to the most recent but update with current time
- use the maximum duration of feeding setting and the application will stop recording the feeding / pumping at the set time if you are unable to press stop

Liquids:
- consider all of your child’s fluid intake (water, expressed breast milk, formula, juice, etc.);
-track your child’s reactions to new fluids and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers;
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Feeding (solid food):
- add solid foods as your child begins eating them (cereal, vegetables, fruits, meat, fish);
- track your child’s reactions to these new foods and leave comments for yourself and other caregivers
- set the default fluid volume (can be edited as needed);

Sleep:
- record the time and duration of your baby’s sleep each day so you can better plan your day;
- compare your baby’s sleep habits with recommended sleep guidelines


Diapers:
- track the number of your baby’s wet and / or dirty diapers. This information is crucial for noticing signs of dehydration, constipation, and diarrhea and alerting the child’s pediatrician if necessary.

Measurements:
- track height and weight to evaluate your baby’s development;

Other features:
- edit or delete events as needed;
- set reminders for various events;
- use the application in your native language (more than 40 languages available);
- select your preferred units of measurement (ounces or milliliters);
- browse graphs;
- view statistics;
- enter data for several children and twins;
- backup all of your data;
and more!

PRO-version
- disable advertising;
- install widgets for quick viewing and launch;
- auto backup every 24 hours;
- export to Excel


We are constantly working to improve the application. Write to us with questions and suggestions.

Enjoy watching your healthy baby grow!

name: Caregiver Planner: Elder Care
description:
Caring for an aging parent is never a one-person job. When reminders, doctor visits, and the "did anyone pick up the prescription?" texts pile up in a chaotic group chat, something always slips. Home Care Organizer gives your whole family one calm, shared place to run it all.

This is an organizer for the logistics of caregiving, not medical advice. It helps you plan, remind, share, and keep track, so the person you love gets steady, coordinated care, and nobody has to carry every detail in their head.

ONE SHARED PLACE, NOT SIX SCATTERED APPS

Instead of a whiteboard, a notes app, three calendars, and a group text nobody scrolls back through, everything lives together. Anyone helping can open the app and instantly see what is done, what is coming up, and who is on it. No more "I thought you had that."

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Build a care profile for your loved one, with name, relationship, and simple notes, so everyone shares the same starting point.

- Keep a shared task list. Add jobs like "pick up prescription" or "call the clinic," assign them to a specific family member, set a due date, and check them off together.

- Track every appointment in one calendar. Add doctor and specialist visits with the provider, location, and notes, then set a reminder (15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, or a day before) so nobody misses one.

- Set medication reminders. Add each medication and the times you want a nudge, then log each one as taken or skipped to keep a clear adherence record. The app reminds you of the time only, and never suggests, adjusts, or comments on what or how much to take.

- Keep a shared care log. Note visits, calls, and updates ("Visited this afternoon, ate well, in good spirits"). Over time it becomes your family's shared memory of how things are really going.

- Save the numbers that matter. Keep the doctor, pharmacy, nurse, and family contacts together so anyone can reach the right person fast.

- Generate prep checklists. Pick a situation, a specialist visit, hospital discharge, home-safety walkthrough, organizing medications, a caregiver rotation, new-diagnosis questions, arranging in-home help, or gathering documents and legal paperwork, and get an organizational checklist: questions to ask, papers to bring, and tasks to divide up. Coordination only, never diagnosis or treatment.

FREE TO START, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED

Jump straight in as a guest, with no sign-up wall. On the free plan you can organize care for one loved one on your own device: unlimited tasks, appointments, and care-log entries, medication reminders, saved contacts, and a sample prep checklist. It is a genuinely useful single-caregiver organizer, at no cost.

GO PRO WHEN THE FAMILY NEEDS TO SHARE

The moment you want to bring siblings and other helpers in, Pro unlocks:

- Cloud family sharing, so tasks, calendar, and the care log stay in sync in real time across everyone's phones.
- Unlimited medication reminder profiles and full history.
- Unlimited prep checklists for every new situation.
- Multiple care recipients, to coordinate for more than one loved one.
- Export your care log and appointment history as a PDF for your own records.
- No ads.

Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription, because caregiving is a season of life. The core organizer stays free, and Pro is there when the whole family needs to be on the same page.

A NOTE ON WHAT THIS APP IS

Home Care Organizer helps you organize and coordinate care. It does not provide medical, dosing, or health advice. For any medical question, please consult a licensed professional; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Get everyone on the same page, so nobody is guessing, and nobody is carrying it alone.

name: The Log: Potty Training + EC
description:
Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Whether you are potty training your toddler or doing elimination communication (EC or infant potty training) with your 0-18 month baby, you need this app!

Observation time is key for knowing your little one’s natural timing intervals (how often s/he goes potty) and keeping track of any baby signals (or “peepee dances”) you see.

But forget that printable log you got from my website! You can now digitally track how often your baby pees or poops during observation time, or potty training, with ease.

If you’ve wondered:

“How often does my baby pee or poop?”

“When should I offer the potty to my little one?”

“If I want to set a potty time reminder on my phone, how long should I set it for?”

…The Log is your answer.

No more paper printouts and chicken-scratch logging, no more guessing “how often does my little actually pee or poop?”…now you can simply open the app and, starting at either waking or feeding, track how often your baby or toddler goes. Then download a PDF of your results.

*You can also take a note of your little one’s signals or other observations by long-pressing the activity button, as you go.

After starting potty training, or if you’re doing EC…after a few hours of observation time (or a few days if you’re really inquisitive)…visit the Reports screen to easily see your baby’s intervals in graph or written format.

Set a potty time alarm based on your baby’s actual timing intervals, so your smart phone can remind you throughout the day when to offer a “pottytunity” - or chance to go potty.

If you have a toddler you’re potty training or wrapping up EC with, you can use this app to set an alarm based on your observations - welcome to your new potty training alarm app!

Track one or more babies, keep the logs separate, and easily re-set the data to start a new observation sesh any time (I recommend you re-log your child’s rhythms every few months or so to keep it fresh!).

Stop over-offering and second-guessing yourself…and become a potty pro (or at least better than you were last week!) with this app.

Developed by me, Andrea Olson, author of Go Diaper Free and The Tiny Potty Training Book, whose 5 children were all out of diapers by walking, none requiring potty trained…a mom who has hardly had to change a poopy diaper and has saved over $10,000 in diapers across their babyhoods…you’re in good hands when it comes to observing your baby for elimination communication. Learn more at godiaperfree.com or via the app, itself.

PS - if you’re stinking at potty training, learn more with the free classes inside the app. If you don’t know what EC is, it’s the natural alternative to diaper dependence and potty training, and it starts as early as birth to 18 months. It’s what people have done for all of human history, long before diapers were invented. We also have a free class and books on that.

name: PainApp: Chronic Pain Relief
description:
Retrain Your Brain. Reclaim a Life Beyond Chronic Pain.
Still living with chronic back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain—or other persistent pain that just won’t go away? Your pain is real. But it may not be coming from where you think.

Requires Subscription.

Pain can be learned by the brain—and the good news is: it can also be unlearned. This app helps you understand how chronic pain works and gives you the tools to gently rewire the brain’s pain pathways.

How Does It Work?
Chronic pain often continues after the body has healed. Why? Because your brain has learned to protect you by activating pain—sometimes even without injury. This is called neural circuit pain, and it’s more common than most people realize.

By using science-backed methods based on neuroplasticity, our app helps you calm the brain’s danger signals, reduce pain, and restore a sense of safety in your body.

Education Is Treatment
Knowledge is so powerful, in fact, that education about pain is a medically recognized form of treatment. Healthcare practitioners call it therapeutic neuroscience education—which is a fancy way of saying that someone is learning how pain really works in the brain.

Scientific studies show that this kind of education can:

Reduce physical pain

Improve movement and function

Lower fear and anxiety

Calm the nervous system

Support long-term recovery

Understanding pain is often the first step to relieving it.

What You’ll Find Inside the App:
Daily science-based lessons to reframe your understanding of pain

Interactive pain tracker to identify patterns and monitor your progress

Guided practices to calm fear and deactivate pain circuits

Tools to identify neural circuit pain vs. structural pain

Strategies for responding to pain triggers with confidence

Exercises that promote safety, movement, and emotional ease

Gentle coaching on how to retrain your brain using proven techniques

Who Is This App For?
You might benefit from this approach if:

You have chronic back pain, neck pain, or shoulder pain

Your pain started during a stressful time or flares with stress

Your pain changes locations, intensity, or comes and goes

You’ve been told “there’s nothing wrong,” but still feel pain

You’ve tried everything—yet nothing has worked long-term

You’re open to a mind-body approach rooted in science, not guesswork

This app is designed for people ready to understand their pain, not just manage it.

Track, Learn, Improve
Our built-in pain tracker helps you:

Log and visualize your pain patterns over time

Notice emotional or situational triggers

Spot progress and build momentum

Feel more empowered in your recovery

No Meds. No Surgery. Just Science.
This is not about positive thinking or ignoring your pain. It’s about giving your brain the right information—and practicing how to respond with calm, not fear. Over time, this helps deconstruct the neural pathways that keep pain alive.

Download Now — Start Rewiring Pain, One Step at a Time
Train your brain. Understand your pain. Live your life again.

name: Pain Tracker & Diary
description:
This app helps you understand and precisely share what you feel daily and keeps track of what types of pain your treatments are helping.

WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?
You hurt. Your pain is chronic and complicated. You can’t remember everything. You want your doctors to understand, but you don’t know how to explain what you feel.

PAIN IS LIFE-CHANGING. HELP IS HERE.
Nanolume® developed the Pain Tracker & Diary to help you record the daily textures, intensities, and locations of what you feel, so you and your care team can better understand what you are suffering with and follow how your pain responds to medications and treatments.

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. In addition, by keeping such an integrated record, trends might emerge that would otherwise go unnoticed.

PAIN IS DIFFERENT.
Pain is a subjective (not objective) sensation that you cannot measure. Its assessment relies on each person’s ability to communicate what they feel. Nanolume® developed this digital diary to help you record what you feel every day.

INCLUDED FEATURES.
For each diary entry you create:
• Choose a Pain Type. Choose from a list of predefined pain types or create a customized pain type. Next, tap the icon of the pain type you feel is most intense (you can come back and add more types later).
• Select the Intensity. Select the intensity of your pain type using a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS).
• Draw an Outline. Use your finger to draw an “outline” of the type of pain you are experiencing on the front and back sides of a generalized map of your body.
• Calculated Surface Areas. The app displays the percent [%] of your body surface affected by each (or all) of the pain types you draw.
• Zoom. Need to see a larger image of your hand or foot? Double-tap: once to zoom x2; twice to zoom x4; a third time to restore the original size.
• Notes. Tap the “Notepad” icon located in the top-left corner of each opened diary entry to record any details of your medications or treatment results.
• Tap "Add Pain." Choose another pain type (layer) to draw.
• Save Your Diary Entry. Tap "Done" to create a snapshot of all the pain type layers you drew. The app attaches the date and time your entry was saved.
• Open a Saved Entry. Tap on the date and time of the entry you want to review. Look at the intensity, location, and surface area of each pain type you experienced (by touching the icon of the pain type you want to see) or see all the pain types at once and see how they overlap (tap the "All Layers" icon). Swipe the picture left or right to check how your other pain entries compare over time.
• Charts. View a summary of your data in "Charts."
• Forget to Save an Entry? Go back and recreate a "pain picture" from the past; then, use the "Calendar" icon to backdate the recreated entry.
• Calendar Backdating. Touch the "Calendar" icon to backdate any pain-picture you draw to create a record of what you remember from the past.
• Copy/Edit. Copy or edit a copy of a previous entry.
• CSV Export. Email or save a numeric file of your data, then open that data in a spreadsheet.
• Interactive Summary & Animation. Play an animation of your data to see how your pain types change within any period you choose by selecting the corresponding start/stop dates.
• PDF Export. Export your charts, drawings, and notes as a PDF file.

PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT.
Your data is stored on your device only and not collected or stored by Nanolume® LLC. Read our End-User License Agreement and Privacy Policy at www.nanolume.com.
