name: Gout Flare Tracker
description:
Living with gout means watching what you eat, staying hydrated, and keeping uric acid under control. Gout Flare Tracker is a simple, private logbook that helps you record flares, track uric acid levels, and check the purine content of foods — so you and your doctor can see the full picture.

Everything is stored on your device. No account required.

KEY FEATURES:
• Flare log with timeline — record each gout attack, the affected joint (body-part picker), pain level, duration and triggers, viewed as a clear date-grouped history.
• Uric acid tracker — log blood test results in mg/dL or µmol/L and watch your trend on an easy-to-read chart over time.
• Purine food database — search 425+ foods with green, yellow and red purine zones, so you can quickly tell which foods to enjoy, limit or avoid.
• Food & meal logging — record what you ate and tie high-purine intake to later flares.
• Medication tracker — log your urate-lowering and pain medicines, track adherence and set reminders so you never miss a dose.
• Hydration log — track daily water intake, since staying hydrated helps flush uric acid.
• Alcohol log — record beer, wine and spirits, common gout triggers worth keeping an eye on.
• Doctor PDF export — generate a clean report of your flares, uric acid history and intake to bring to your next appointment.
• Charts & insights — spot patterns between diet, hydration, medication and your flare-ups.
• Reminders — gentle medication and hydration nudges to help you stay consistent.

WHY CHOOSE GOUT FLARE TRACKER?
• Private by design — your health data stays on your phone, no sign-up needed.
• Built around gout — purine zones, uric-acid units and flare triggers, not a generic health app.
• Doctor-friendly — export a tidy PDF summary for any appointment.
• Clean and simple — log a flare or a glass of water in seconds.
• Works offline — the full purine database and all your logs are available without internet.

PERFECT FOR:
• People managing gout or hyperuricemia day to day.
• Anyone on urate-lowering therapy who wants to track medication and results.
• Patients who want to bring organized records to their rheumatologist or GP.
• Anyone watching purine intake, hydration or alcohol to reduce flares.

A note on safety: Gout Flare Tracker is a personal logging tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Purine values are based on published nutrition data and are for general reference. Always follow the guidance of your doctor or pharmacist.

Download Gout Flare Tracker and take control of your gout — one log at a time.

name: Lupus Flare Tracker
description:
Living with lupus means never knowing when the next flare will hit, explaining an invisible illness, and managing lifelong medication. Lunaire Lupus Tracker is a private, offline flare and symptom diary built for patients who are tired of cloud-based apps, ads, and accounts that harvest their health data. Every flare, joint ache, rash, fatigue episode, and missed dose you log stays on your phone, always.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK
• Lupus flare severity and duration
• Joint pain location and intensity
• Malar (butterfly) rash, discoid rash, and skin changes
• Fatigue and energy levels
• Mouth and nose ulcers
• Hair loss
• Raynaud's episodes
• Brain fog and cognitive symptoms
• Fever and photosensitivity
• Medications — hydroxychloroquine, steroids, immunosuppressants, biologics
• Medication adherence and missed doses
• Blood test dates and appointment reminders
• Food, exercise, mood, sleep, and 30+ other symptoms
• Weight and body changes

PRIVACY-FIRST BY DESIGN
Most lupus apps need an account, run ads, or sync your health data to their servers. Ours does not.
✓ No accounts. No sign-up. Open the app and start logging.
✓ No cloud. Your data lives in a local database only you control.
✓ No ads. Ever.
✓ No tracking. No analytics.
✓ Full offline — works with no internet, anywhere.

UNDERSTAND YOUR FLARES
Lupus flares are notoriously unpredictable — but patterns exist. Lunaire keeps your symptoms, suspected triggers (sun exposure, stress, missed meds, poor sleep, infection, food), and medication adherence side by side, so you can read your own data over time. Deeper symptom-and-trigger correlation analysis is part of Premium.

PDF REPORTS FOR YOUR DOCTOR
A 15-minute appointment isn't long enough to describe six months of symptoms from memory. Generate a clean PDF report of your flare frequency, joint pain patterns, fatigue cycles, and medication adherence — ready to email, print, or share with your doctor, rheumatologist, or lupus specialist.

BUILT FOR LUPUS PATIENTS
Every category, symptom list, and chart was designed around what lupus patients actually track: flare triggers, malar rashes, joint flares, sun sensitivity, medication side effects, and the daily reality of living with SLE.

If you live with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), discoid lupus, drug-induced lupus, overlap syndromes, or undifferentiated connective tissue disease, this tracker is built for you.

PREMIUM FEATURES

Lupus is unpredictable. Track yours — privately.

Premium is available as an affordable monthly / yearly subscription or a lifetime one-time purchase.

name: Gout Flare Diet Tracker: Urica
description:
Finally understand YOUR gout triggers — not just generic advice that hasn't worked. Urica is the gout tracker app built for people who want answers, not lectures.

Urica is a smart gout tracker that goes beyond simple purine counting. Using AI-powered food scanning and personal pattern analysis, Urica helps you discover what actually causes YOUR flares.

WHY URICA IS DIFFERENT

Traditional gout apps tell you to avoid purines. But here's what they miss: dietary purines only account for about 30% of your uric acid levels. That's why generic gout diet advice often doesn't stop flares.

Urica tracks the full picture:
★ Purines (what you expect)
★ Fructose (hidden factor that affects uric acid excretion)
★ Glycemic load (insulin spikes reduce kidney clearance)
★ Sleep, stress, and hydration patterns

Then our AI finds correlations between YOUR lifestyle and YOUR gout flares.

POWERFUL FEATURES

◆ AI Food Scanner
Photograph any meal for instant analysis. Get purine estimates, fructose content, glycemic impact, and smart swap suggestions — all in seconds.

◆ Gout Flare & Tingle Tracking
Log gout flares with severity and location. Plus, track that "tingle" feeling before a full flare hits — your early warning system.

◆ Personal Trigger Discovery
Our AI analyzes your data over time to identify YOUR specific gout triggers. Not generic lists — patterns unique to your body.

◆ Daily Context Tracking
Log sleep quality, stress levels, and hydration. These factors significantly impact uric acid clearance and gout flare frequency.

◆ Doctor's Report
Export a comprehensive PDF with your gout flare history, dietary patterns, and AI insights to share with your healthcare team.

◆ Protective Foods
We highlight foods that help — cherries, coffee, vitamin C sources — not just what to avoid.

THE SCIENCE-BACKED APPROACH

Gout is primarily an excretion problem, not just a diet problem. Most gout patients are "under-excreters" due to metabolic factors like insulin resistance. Urica is built on this modern understanding of gout management.

We don't lecture. We don't judge. We help you become a scientist studying your own body.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

Free:
- Basic meal logging
- Flare tracking
- Educational content

Premium:
- Unlimited AI food scans
- Full correlation insights
- Personal trigger reports
- Doctor's report export
- Priority support

If avoiding red meat hasn't stopped your gout flares, it's time to track the full picture. Download Urica — the gout diet tracker that goes beyond purine lists — and find your real triggers.

DISCLAIMER
This app is for informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your doctor or qualified healthcare provider about your gout management.

name: SpaceWeatherLive
description:
SpaceWeatherLive is the ultimate app for those who are interested in seeing the northern lights or want to know everything about the activity on our Sun. You will never miss an aurora display again with this app in your pocket no matter where you go!

Beginner friendly - While the SpaceWeatherLive app is filled with all the space weather information you can think of both for beginning and advanced space weather enthusiasts, every item has a pop up with additional information to help you along if something is unclear. Learn more as you go along!

Everything in one app - Switch between the auroral activity and solar activity modes with just one click!

Dark mode - Preserve your night vision with our special dark mode! Ideal for aurora chasing out in the field!

Push notifications - Free push notifications informing you of significant space weather events like solar flares, geomagnetic storms, earth-facing coronal holes and much more! Modern graphs - All the data that you are interested in are represented in sleek, responsive graphs. Dials don't cut it when you are out in the field, you want to know how the data looks like in the past and right now. Our graphs provide all the information you need in the blink of an eye!

News - Not only do we provide a ton of different automated alerts, we even have a dedicated team of space weather enthusiasts who write detailed hand written reports during high solar or auroral activity!

Extensive help section - Are you a beginner and does our app look a bit daunting when you first open it? Fear not, we have a dedicated help section with tons of articles and a FAQ section. Give it a read and soon you will be able to make your very own aurora forecasts!

Huge space weather archive - Ever looked back at your old aurora pictures and wonder what space weather was like on that specific date? We got you covered! Take a dive in our space weather archive that is filled to the brim with geomagnetic and solar data from the year 1996 until yesterday. Dig around and discover large sunspot regions, extreme geomagnetic storms and exciting data from the past!

description:
NEO Tracker: NASA Asteroid Tracker & Space Radar


🚀 Track near-Earth asteroids in real-time with official NASA data! NEO Tracker is the ultimate asteroid tracker app that monitors potentially hazardous asteroids, delivers space alerts, and shows stunning 3D orbital views.

Whether you're an astronomy enthusiast or just curious about what's flying past Earth, this asteroid radar keeps you informed with live NASA updates.

⭐ Why Choose NEO Tracker?


✅ OFFICIAL NASA DATA — Real-time asteroid tracking from NASA's API
✅ FREE — No registration, no subscription required
✅ INSTANT ALERTS — Know when asteroids approach Earth
✅ BEAUTIFUL UI — Dark mode, smooth animations, easy navigation

🔥 Key Features



📰 CNEOS News & Asteroid Alerts
Stay updated with breaking news about potentially hazardous asteroids (PHAs). Get notifications when significant near-Earth objects are detected.

☄️ Today's Asteroids
See every asteroid passing Earth today. View miss distance, diameter, velocity, and magnitude at a glance.

📅 Weekly Asteroid Schedule
Plan ahead! Check all asteroids approaching Earth over the next 7 days, organized by date.

⚠️ Sentry Impact Watchlist
Access NASA's Sentry system — the official list of asteroids with potential Earth impact risk. Monitor planetary defense data like a pro.

🌍 3D Orbital Viewer
Visualize asteroid orbits in stunning 3D! See exactly how close NEOs pass to Earth with interactive orbital mechanics.

🔔 Push Notifications
Enable alerts to never miss significant asteroid approaches or NASA announcements.

💾 Save & Share
Bookmark your favorite asteroids and share discoveries with friends instantly.

🤖 AI Space Assistant
Got questions about asteroids? Ask our built-in AI assistant! Learn about orbital mechanics, asteroid classification, impact risks, and more — like having a NASA expert in your pocket.

📊 What is a Near-Earth Object (NEO)?


Near-Earth Objects are asteroids and comets that orbit within 1.3 AU of the Sun. NASA tracks thousands of these objects daily. Some are classified as Potentially Hazardous Asteroids (PHAs) if they pass within 0.05 AU of Earth.

🛡️ What is NASA Sentry?


Sentry is NASA's automated collision monitoring system. It continuously scans asteroid trajectories to identify objects that could impact Earth in the next 100 years.

📱 How to Use NEO Tracker


1️⃣ Install the app — No account needed
2️⃣ Browse today's asteroids or weekly schedule
3️⃣ Tap any asteroid for detailed metrics
4️⃣ View 3D orbits to visualize approaches
5️⃣ Ask the AI assistant any space question
6️⃣ Enable notifications for alerts
7️⃣ Share interesting discoveries!

❓ FAQ



Is this app really free?
Yes! 100% free with no registration. Minimal ads help cover server costs.

Where does the data come from?
All data comes directly from NASA's official APIs (CNEOS, NEO, Sentry).

How many asteroids pass Earth daily?
On average, 10-15 tracked asteroids pass near Earth every day.

What do the units mean?
Tap the help icon for a complete guide to LD (Lunar Distance), AU, magnitude, and more.

🌟 Perfect For


• Astronomy enthusiasts
• Space fans & stargazers
• Science educators & students
• Anyone curious about asteroids!

📧 Contact & Support


Questions? Suggestions? We'd love to hear from you!
Email: contact@tchapacan.net

Developed by Tchapacan with 💙 for space exploration

name: Doctor On Demand
description:
Doctor On Demand by Included Health offers 24/7 access to board-certified doctors, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists via secure video visits from your phone, tablet, or computer. Fast Access to Online Doctors – See a board-certified, US-based provider with telehealth appointments anytime, day or night.

Doctor’s Notes – Need a doctor’s note for work or school? We’ve got you covered. See an urgent care provider for help.

Insurance or Self-Pay – We work with major health plans and many employers to reduce the costs of visits for eligible members. If not covered, we offer affordable visit costs to all patients with no surprise bills.

 1. Download the app and create an account for free.

Frequently Asked Questions
🕒 When are doctors available?
Our virtual providers are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Mental health appointments are often available within days—much faster than traditional providers who can take weeks

💲 How much does a visit cost?
You’ll always see your exact visit cost upfront. We accept most insurance plans and partner with top employers and health plans to lower your costs. No insurance? Our telehealth visit costs are affordable.

👩‍⚕️ Who are the doctors?
Our US-based, board-certified doctors, licensed psychiatrists, and therapists have an average of 15 years of experience and come from diverse specialties to ensure you receive expert care.

🤳How does it work?
Join a telehealth visit to connect face to face with a provider from your phone, tablet, or computer in as little as ten minutes. Like an in-person visit, your provider will discuss with you how you’re feeling, your healthcare history, and propose a recommended treatment plan. Labs, screenings, and prescriptions will be sent to nearby facilities.

Our urgent care doctors can treat hundreds of issues, including cold and flu, urinary tract infections, allergies, headache, sprains, and skin conditions. They can also order labs and screenings to help with preventative care and help manage chronic care conditions. Our extensive team of therapists and psychiatrists are able to treat anxiety, stress, depression, PTSD, trauma and loss relationships, and more.

Your Privacy is Our Priority
We adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines to protect your health data and personal information.

Our providers are unable to prescribe controlled substances.

Join millions of patients who trust Doctor On Demand for fast, convenient, and reliable healthcare. Download the app now to sign up for free!

• Move to the next step after successful wake-ups

Shifti is built for late sleepers, night owls, students, professionals, and anyone who wants to build a better morning routine without restarting from zero after one bad day.

Wake tasks help make your alarm harder to ignore. You can choose a simple hold task, solve quick math challenges, or scan a saved barcode away from your bed to confirm you are awake.

Shifti also includes loud alarm protection, wake confirmation, snooze, reboot rescheduling, and progress tracking to help make your wake-up routine more reliable.

Why Shifti is different:

Most alarm clock apps only ring. Shifti helps you plan your sleep schedule before the alarm rings. It combines a gradual sleep schedule plan, bedtime reminders, wake tasks, and progress tracking so you can build consistency step by step.

Use Shifti to:

• Fix your sleep schedule gradually
• Stop waking up late
• Build a better morning routine
• Shift your bedtime earlier
• Wake up with a smarter alarm
• Reduce missed mornings
• Stay consistent after setbacks
• Follow a clear sleep reset plan

Shifti is not a medical app and does not diagnose, treat, or cure sleep disorders. It is designed to support better sleep habits, bedtime routines, and wake-up consistency.

Start small. Wake better. Fix your sleep schedule 15 minutes at a time.

Fast Company: “Congratulations Timeshifter on helping to change the world.”

Timeshifter — Shift Work Edition — was developed to help shift workers reduce the underlying problem of circadian and sleep disruption inherent in shift work. With Timeshifter, you will receive highly personalized advice based on your sleep pattern, chronotype, work schedule, and personal preferences.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

It’s time to replace the myths with real science.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

WHY SHIFT WORKERS LOVE TIMESHIFTER

// Based on the latest sleep and circadian science
// Optimizes your sleep, alertness, and performance
// Reduces the negative effects of shift work on productivity, health, and quality of life

Using Timeshifter is as simple as taking small actions at specific times.

KEY FEATURES

// Advice Notifications: Get timely advice even without opening the app

NO EXPENSIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED

Timeshifter is a highly empowering experience, and it requires no special equipment. Just a sleep mask and your favorite dark sunglasses.

⊗ Typing every shift into a generic calendar app by hand

Shift It fixes all of that

WHY SHIFT WORKERS SWITCH TO SHIFT IT
Most shift apps make you type in every shift. Shift It reads your roster file and does it for you.

Most shift apps don't touch pay. Shift It calculates what your award says you're owed – night and weekend penalties, tiered overtime, allowances, on-call recalls, minimum engagement – and compares it to your payslip. If there's a discrepancy, you'll know, and you can share the proof.

Gross pay only – the number you compare against your payslip. Tax estimates sound useful until salary packaging or HECS makes them wrong by thousands.

▪ Calendar export to Google Calendar

PRO – KNOW WHAT YOU'RE OWED

▪ Payslip comparison flags discrepancies between what you earned and what you were paid

▪ Detailed PDF and CSV exports of timesheets, calendar, and pay estimates – useful for payroll disputes
▪ Multiple Employers with separate awards, locations, and pay rules

▪ Location groups to track shifts across multiple sites

--

BUILT FOR SHIFT WORKER WELLBEING
Shift work affects your health. Shift It helps you see it.
The Daylight card shows how your shifts align with sunrise and sunset, tracks your sunlight exposure, and nudges you with evidence-based advice for night shifts, early starts, and short turnarounds. Break Timer keeps your rest periods honest. Minimum engagement alerts flag when you've been sent home early and may be owed more.
Because knowing your schedule is one thing – knowing how it affects you is another.

name: Twilight: Blue light filter
description:
Are you having trouble falling asleep? Are your kids hyperactive when playing with the tablet before bed time?
Are you using your smart phone or tablet in the late evening? Are you sensitive to light during migraine?
Twilight may be a solution for you!

Recent research suggests that exposure to blue light before sleep may distort your natural (circadian) rhythm and cause inability to fall asleep.

The cause is the photoreceptor in your eyes, called Melanopsin. This receptor is sensitive to a narrow band of blue light in the 460-480nm range which may suppress Melatonin production - a hormone responsible for your healthy sleep-wake cycles.

In experimental scientific studies it has been shown an average person reading on a tablet or smart phone for a couple of hours before bed time may find their sleep delayed by about an hour. See references below..

The Twilight app makes your device screen adapt to the time of the day. It filters the flux of blue light emitted by your phone or tablet after sunset and protects your eyes with a soft and pleasant red filter. The filter intensity is smoothly adjusted to the sun cycle based on your local sunset and sunrise times.

You can also use Twilight on your Wear OS device.

Documentation
http://twilight.urbandroid.org/doc/

Get more from Twilight
1) Bed reading: Twilight is more pleasant on the eyes for night reading. Especially as it is able to lower the screen backlight far below the ability of the backligt controls on your screen

2) AMOLED screens: We have tested Twilight on an AMOLED screen for 5 years without any sign of depletion or over-burning. If properly configured Twilight causes less light emission (by enabling dimming) with more equal light distribution (dark areas of the screen such as the status bar get tinted). This may in fact increase your AMOLED screen life time.

Basics on circadian rhythm and the role of melatonin
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melatonin
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Melanopsin
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circadian_rhythms
http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circadian_rhythm_disorder

Permissions
- location - to find out your current sunset/surise times
- running apps - to stop Twilight in selected apps
- write settings - to set back-light
- network - access smartlight (Philips HUE) to shield you household light from blue

Accessibility Service

In order to filter also your notifications and lock screen the app may ask for enabling Twilight Accessibility Service. The app uses this service only to better filter your screen and does not collect any personal information. Please read more about this at https://twilight.urbandroid.org/is-twilights-accessibility-service-a-thread-to-my-privacy/

Wear OS

Twilight also syncs your Wear OS screen with your phone's filter settings. You can control filtering from a "Wear OS Tile".

Automation (Tasker or other)
https://sites.google.com/site/twilight4android/automation

Related scientific research

Amplitude Reduction and Phase Shifts of Melatonin, Cortisol and Other Circadian Rhythms after a Gradual Advance of Sleep and Light Exposure in Humans Derk-Jan Dijk, & Co 2012

Exposure to Room Light before Bedtime Suppresses Melatonin Onset and Shortens Melatonin Duration in Humans Joshua J. Gooley, Kyle Chamberlain, Kurt A. Smith & Co, 2011

Effect of Light on Human Circadian Physiology Jeanne F. Duffy, Charles A. Czeisler 2009

Efficacy of a single sequence of intermittent bright light pulses for delaying circadian phase in humans Claude Gronfier, Kenneth P. Wright, & Co 2009

name: Quiet Sleep: Thought Dump
description:
Quiet Sleep is a calm bedtime ritual for people whose thoughts get loud at night. Use a private thought dump, guided breathing, cognitive shuffle, and calm sleep sounds to put the day down before sleep.

When you lie down, your mind can keep replaying plans, unfinished tasks, worries, conversations, and tomorrow's to-dos. Quiet Sleep gives those thoughts a place outside your head so your evening can feel simpler and more contained.

No ads. No account required. No social feed. No streak pressure. Quiet Sleep is designed for a short nightly routine, then putting the phone away.

What you can do in Quiet Sleep:

• Dump thoughts by text or voice
Write or speak whatever is still active in your mind. It does not need to be neat, complete, or well written. Fragments, lists, and unfinished thoughts are welcome.

• Use a short session timer
Choose a simple timed session so your bedtime routine stays contained. The goal is to place thoughts outside your head, not stay in the app longer than needed.

• Practice guided breathing
Choose from 4-7-8 breathing, box breathing, equal breathing, long exhale, coherent breathing, and the physiological sigh. Follow the calm circle, set your cycle count, and adjust cues for tonight.

• Try cognitive shuffle
Let the app show or speak simple random words so your mind can move through gentle, unrelated images instead of looping on the same thoughts.

• Play sleep sounds with a timer
Rain, nighttime atmospheres, white noise, purring, and other relaxing sounds help shape a softer bedtime environment. Set the timer and volume, then let the sound end on its own.

• Track evenings in a calendar
See entries, mood, sleep rating, breathing sessions, and shuffle sessions by day. Notice patterns without scores, streaks, or judgment.

• Get gentle reflection on entries
Quiet Sleep can highlight themes and the overall tone of your thoughts so you can look at them with more distance. It is reflection, not therapy or diagnosis.

• Keep private data on your device
Entries, settings, and history are stored locally on your device. You can protect sensitive text with a PIN, export your data, and control what stays in the app.

Quiet Sleep may be helpful if you:

• replay thoughts at bedtime;
• want a private bedtime journal;
• need a simple nighttime relaxation routine;
• prefer a minimal sleep app with no ads;
• use journaling, guided breathing, cognitive shuffle, or sleep sounds;
• want one place for evening reflection;
• care about privacy and local storage.

Quiet Sleep is not a medical app, does not diagnose conditions, and does not replace professional care. If sleep, anxiety, or stress is seriously affecting your life, please contact a doctor or qualified professional.

Put the day down. Give your thoughts a place. Let the night get quieter.

description:
Ploi is a plant care tracker for people who want to remember what they did and when. Log every watering, build a care history for each plant, and let Ploi learn your routine instead of following a generic schedule.

Watering reminders that learn

No app can tell you exactly how often to water your plants: it depends on light, humidity, pot size and season. So Ploi learns instead of guessing. Log a watering, and Ploi picks up your real rhythm and moves the next reminder to match. The more you log, the better the reminders fit.

A journal for every plant

Every watering, feeding, repotting and note goes into that plant's own timeline, and you can scroll back through it any time. Weeks later you can see exactly when you last fertilized, how long the plant went without water, or the day a new leaf appeared. It is a care log and a plant diary in one.

Growth photos over time

Add a photo to any log entry and watch your plant's story come together. A fiddle leaf fig, a monstera, a snake plant or a peace lily all look different six months on, and Ploi keeps every photo so you can see the change for yourself.

Care guides by species

Ploi includes care guides for individual plant species, covering watering, light, soil and humidity. Look up what your plant needs instead of relying on a generic houseplant article.

Plant identification

Not sure what you have? Take a photo and Ploi identifies the species, then starts a care log for it. Most people start with identification — but what Ploi is really for is everything you record afterwards.

Wishlist and rooms

Keep a wishlist of plants you want, and group the ones you own by room or windowsill, so you can water everything in one trip around the house.

Built for people who like to keep records

When did I last water this? How has it changed? Which routine actually worked? Ploi answers all three.

Subscribe for unlimited plants and advanced care features.

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

name: PlantTAGG Plant Care Gardening
description:
Success in gardening is based on one thing – credible plant information! PlantTAGG makes it easy to identify plants, determine the best plant care, and maximize your plant health. Home gardening has never been easier! PlantTAGG’s AI and plant database is built by plant experts, specifically for North America.

PlantTAGG is here to answer common gardening issues and plant care questions. Will this plant grow in my yard? Can you suggest a plant for my landscape design? How do I care for each of my plants? I follow the guidance on the printed plant tags but seem to struggle - what am I doing wrong? What are appropriate companion plants to supplement my home’s landscaping that are appropriate for my climate and location? Need to identify a plant and determine where to get one?

PlantTAGG is the smartest mobile gardening app available for North America. Our plant content is comprised of thousands of plant species and cultivars which were licensed from leading horticulture universities. Each profile is then hand crafted and curated by Master Gardeners and plant experts to ensure accuracy, detail, plant care information and credibility. PlantTAGG is uniquely able to localize suggested care tasks and tips specific for your geographic location using NOAA data, data science/AI and 1500 care rules. Our AI algorithms compute a season map for your specific yard based on first/last average freeze dates, extreme heat, freeze and average temperatures, sunlight, precipitation, and other local climatic data.

Want to make a good plant selection for your yard's unique micro-climates? PlantTAGG's proprietary 'Thrive Scorecard' can predict the success you will have with a plant based on your exact location, sunlight, moisture, and climate. Easily optimize your garden layout and plant care routine before planting.

Want to know precisely when and how to fertilize, prune and deal with pests and disease for each unique plant? PlantTAGG’s tasks and tips are crafted and curated by horticulture experts and tailored for your specific home and yard location. As you use PlantTAGG's care tasks the system gets smarter. Want to add a custom scheduled care task for a specific plant - no problem!

Having challenges with a specific plant or have a gardening or landscaping question? Meet “Emily”, our AI plant and gardening expert who is available to help 24x7 with highly localized and specific answers based on plant variety, your home’s location, planting conditions and even time of year. She can identify 80 different pests and diseases from your submitted pictures and tell you how to resolve them.

Easily identify plants on the go with PlantTAGG's Plant/TagID. Our best-in-class plant identifier can provide you with the information you need and the ideal plant care guide. PlantTAGG can also identify a plant and present plant details by taking a picture of a printed plant tag or pot sticker. Once you have identified a plant, add it to your ‘Favorites’ for later research and purchase.

Want help with your yard maintenance or landscaping project? PlantTAGG's home landscape design styles and material calculators will help you visualize and achieve success. Our partnership with ‘Plant By Number’ includes all their landscape design style products to choose from.

Let PlantTAGG become your personal home gardening expert! Optimize your plant care, plant health, and achieve gardening success!

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

You can become a registered member of BoardGameGeek (BGG) for free, and we welcome your contributions in the form of ratings, reviews, and thoughts on games!

BGG features reviews, ratings, images, play-aids, translations, and session reports from board game geeks around the world, as well as live discussion forums.

Here you’ll find many types of board games, including thousands you’ve probably never seen in a store. We cover not only board games but also dice games, card games, tile-laying games, and games of dexterity. We have abstracts, economic games, dungeon crawls, city building, diplomacy and negotiation, trading, puzzle games, strategy games, party games, war games, and many more. name: Clue: Official Hasbro Game
description:
Join fellow detectives all over the world in the official digital board game version of Clue! Gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the original murder mystery.

Follow Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Professor Plum, Chef White, Solicitor Peacock and Mayor Green through the iconic Tudor Mansion, unlocking their motives and alibis as you go.

Enjoy Clue the way you remember it in Classic Mode, or jump in for a quick game with Clue Cards mode. Alternatively, if you want to really test your sleuthing skills, try a new investigation format available exclusively to Clue – Ultimate Detective.

In Ultimate Detective Mode, everyone answers suggestions at the same time…but secretly!

Face your suspects in a direct interrogation as you rely on your skills of deduction to get to the truth. Experience the mystery, solve the murder and become a top-tier detective!

HOW TO PLAY CLUE:

1. Three cards are dealt face-down and set aside – this is the solution to the crime!
2. Everyone is dealt three Clue Cards. These are automatically crossed off your clue sheet, as they can’t be part of the solution.
3. Roll the dice and move around the board.
4. When you enter a room, you can make a suggestion – select who you think the murderer is, what weapon they used and where the crime happened.
5. Other players will then aim to disprove your suggestion; if one of your suggestions matches a card in their hand, they show you that card to disprove it.
6. Use your clue sheet to keep track of which characters, weapons and rooms have been disproven.
7. Think you’ve figured it out? It’s time to make an accusation! Be careful though – if you’re right, you win, but if you are wrong, you’re out!

FEATURES

- THE CLASSIC TUDOR MANSION – Play the beloved original board game, now rendered in stunning 3D animation and entirely ad-free!
- A BRAND-NEW GAME MODE – Exclusive to the digital version of Clue, Ultimate Detective Mode lets you interrogate multiple characters at once.
- MULTIPLE MODES – Compete against advanced AI opponents that adjust to your skill level for the ideal game, or challenge detectives worldwide.
- ADDITIONAL ORIGINAL CONTENT – What happened after the shocking events of Tudor Mansion? Find out in a series of original new crime scenes designed specifically for the digital version of Cluedo! New characters emerge, bringing with them new clues, motives and case files to consider as you travel around the world in search of the truth.

Sharpen your mind with the iconic murder-mystery board game, now available on mobile!

Nous favorisons également l'utilisation d'ingrédients de saison, des recettes ayant un faible impact sur l'environnement, et nous encourageons la réduction du gaspillage alimentaire. Avec Pancia, vous pourrez prendre soin de votre bien-être tout en étant respectueux de la planète.

The recipe converter tool allows you to scale, multiply, divide, or portion your recipes to the serving size you desire. Easily convert recipes to your desired serving size by typing in (*or copying and pasting*) the ingredients from your favorite online food blogs or recipe sites.

*Note: Due to the nature of text formatting, the copy and paste function may not work directly for some websites and certain mobile browsers.

The ingredient unit converter tool allows you to convert by ingredient between volume and weight units, such as cups and grams. Choose from more than 250 of the most common ingredients, such as butter, eggs, flour, and sugar!

The tool also includes basic conversion calculators for Volume, Weight, Length, Energy, Time, and Temperature. For most conversions, you can directly type in fractions as an input value, such as "1 1/2" or "3/4". The tool also keeps a history of your past conversions.

In addition to conversion calculators, the app has a Gas Mark reference and a cooking temperature references that allows you to quickly look up information about cooking temperatures for meat, candy, and other dishes.

Take the power of recipe conversion with you by downloading this app. MyKitchenCalculator.com, recipe conversion made easier!

Recipe Converter:
Multiply, divide, or portion recipes with ease. This tool will take fraction inputs and output them to the nearest fraction also!

Ingredient Unit Converter:
Convert by ingredient between common volume and weight units for more than 250 ingredients! Includes sticks of butter conversion and conversion of medium, large, and x-large whole eggs!

Volume Converter:
Convert between units of teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons, fluid ounces, milliliters, liters. You can also convert between US and UK (imperial) units. There is also a conversion to "Cups and Spoons". This conversion will convert volume units to denominations of common measuring cups and spoons. For example, 1.75 cups = 1 cup + 3/4 cup.

Weight Converter:
Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Energy Converter:
Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:
View common gas mark settings in Fahrenheit or Celsius.

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:
1)Conversions are calculated approximations and may not be exact.
2)US volume conversions are NIST based rounded values.
3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.
5)This tool is based on rounded and simplified values and is not recommended for mathematical, engineering, or scientific calculations that need precision.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

Split the bill item by item, not down the middle. SplitHappens scans the receipt and everyone takes their own items.

Dinner was good. Then the bill arrives, and someone has to work out who had the salad, who shared the dessert, and who is covering it all.

Point SplitHappens at the receipt. It reads every line item, everyone taps what they had, and the app works out who owes what. Restaurants, shared groceries, a holiday with friends: splitting expenses takes seconds.

Free, no ads, no subscription.

EVERYONE PAYS FOR THEIR OWN ITEMS
- Individual items get split, not just the total
- Whoever had one soda pays for one soda, not a quarter of everything
- A single item can be shared too: the starter you split, the bottle of wine for the table
- Everyone sees the same bill, live. No more passing screenshots around.

SCAN THE RECEIPT
- Take a photo: restaurants, supermarkets, hotels, cafés
- The scanner picks up items, prices and quantities
- Anything it gets wrong, you fix with a tap
- Works with more than 30 currencies

GUESTS DO NOT NEED AN ACCOUNT
- Anyone without the app joins by name
- A link shows a guest what they owe in the browser – nothing to install, nothing to sign up for
- If they create an account later, their existing bills come with them

EVENTS FOR TRIPS, HOUSEHOLDS AND GROUPS
- One event for a holiday, the people you live with, a birthday or the weekly pub night
- Every bill in one place, everyone included automatically
- Log an expense in another currency and it converts on its own
- At the end the app tells you who pays whom, in as few transfers as possible

THREE WAYS TO ADD A BILL
- With a receipt: take the photo and the items get read for you
- Without a receipt: enter the total and add the items yourself
- Quick Split: just the total, divided evenly
Items can be split evenly, by shares, by percentage or with custom amounts.

SETTLING UP
- Balances net off across bills: you owe €30, you are owed €10, so €20 is left
- Clear everything between two people in a single tap
- Add your PayPal address or IBAN so nobody has to ask where to send it

ADDING FRIENDS
- Add a friend by QR code in seconds
- Share events and bills by link
- No public profiles, no friend suggestions. Your contacts stay yours.

GOOD FOR
- Restaurants and bars where everyone ordered something different
- Living with other people: scan the grocery receipt, everyone takes their own items
- Trips and group holidays: one event, settled up at the end
- Spontaneous rounds: add someone as a guest and split straight away
- Anyone after a free alternative to the subscription apps

YOUR DATA
- Bills, profiles and balances sit on our own server in Germany
- No ad tracking, no ads, nothing passed on to advertisers
- Export everything as CSV whenever you want
- Delete your account in the app – no questions, no support email needed
- Light or dark, following your system settings

SplitHappens is built by one person in Germany. If something breaks or you are missing something, write to support@splithappens.io – it goes straight to the developer.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

name: Liverpool HEP iChart
description:
Description:
Healthcare professionals and patients should use this application to search for potential drug-drug interactions between hepatitis drugs and other medications, as recommended by international treatment guidelines. Results are presented as a “Traffic Light” system (red, amber, yellow, green) to indicate the recommendation. A brief summary of each interaction is given. The application is available free of charge and has been developed by the Liverpool Drug Interactions Group at the University of Liverpool and Clubzap Ltd.

Requirements:
This is an “offline” application that is downloaded to your device. An internet connection is not required to use the application, but is needed for downloading updates.

Why this application may be useful:
In hepatitis therapy, patients take more than one hepatitis medication at a time and possibly other drugs to treat co-existing conditions. Many of the drug combinations have the potential to interact and this can affect either the patient's safety or the effectiveness of treatment. For this reason some drug combinations should not be given at all, while other drugs may be used together with caution, possibly requiring adjustments to dosage or time of administration. This application is a guide to interactions that may occur between different hepatitis drugs and other medications that the HCV- and/or HBV-infected patient may be prescribed. The application is regularly updated as new data emerge. Full details about the interactions can be found at www.hep-druginteractions.org.

For this reason some drug combinations should not be given at all, while other drugs may be used together with caution, possibly requiring adjustments to dosage or time of administration. name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.

Zero-Setup Onboarding. No calendars to connect, no categories to build. Open the app, share what's on your mind, and get your first step in seconds.

WHO UNTANGLE IS FOR
If you've ever known exactly what you needed to do and still couldn't start, Untangle was built for that gap. It's for anyone stuck between a full to-do list and an empty sense of where to begin: students facing deadlines, professionals juggling too many priorities, and anyone tired of to-do apps that just make the list longer.

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
Traditional productivity apps assume your problem is organization. But if you're already overwhelmed, a better filing system doesn't help you start. Untangle is built around a different idea: the bottleneck isn't knowing what to do, it's the bridge between thought and action. So instead of asking you to organize, plan, and prioritize, Untangle removes all of that and hands you just the next step.

REAL PEOPLE, REAL RESULTS
Untangle has helped students push through to graduation, helped professionals clear task backlogs that had piled up for weeks, and helped countless people go from staring at a blank screen to finally getting moving. People tell us it's the first productivity app that didn't make them feel more behind than when they started.

A FEW THINGS PEOPLE ASK
Do I need to organize anything before I start? No. Skip the folders and categories. Just open the app and say what's on your mind.

Is this just another to-do list? No. To-do lists assume you're stuck on organizing. Untangle assumes you're stuck on starting, and solves for that instead.

GET STARTED FREE
Download Untangle, share what's on your mind, and let Aaron give you your first step. No complicated setup. No long tutorials. Just one small step, right now.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your brain dumps and tasks are yours. Untangle is built with privacy in mind, so you can share what's really on your mind without worry.

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

name: Extrovert or Introvert Test
description:
This test measures the personality trait of extraversion.

Personality traits are relatively stable over time, but they can and often do gradually change as you age.

People who are more extraverted tend to feel energized by social interactions, enjoy meeting and socializing with people, and are often the center of attention. They are often perceived as outgoing, social, full of energy, enthusiastic, and action-oriented.

People who are more introverted tend to feel drained by social interactions, prefer a good amount of solitude, and dislike small talk. They are often perceived as quiet, low-key, and deliberate. They need less stimulation and more time alone than extraverts.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

• Ingredient photos — Capture a clear photo of the ingredient list on the packaging; on-device text recognition (Google ML Kit) extracts the text, which is then checked with the same keyword logic as ingredient text from the database. Recognition works best with Latin script; other scripts may not read reliably—always verify the physical label.

• On-device translation — Choose how to show ingredients: match your device language with automatic translation (Google ML Kit on device), or show the original text from Open Food Facts.
• Saved scans — Save products with custom names; open, review, or delete them later.
• Settings — Update your allergen profile and ingredient language anytime.
• Contribute — Jump to Open Food Facts to improve data (photos, structured allergens, details).

Important — Allergy Food Alert relies on open community data and on-device recognition; neither is guaranteed complete or accurate. Photo and text recognition can misread words or miss lines. It is not medical or legal advice. Manufacturers can change recipes before databases update. Always read the physical product label before you buy or eat—especially if your allergy is severe.

name: Open Food Facts
description:

In short, we're kind of "the Wikipedia of food", as many have nicknamed the project. Open Food Facts has enabled the creation of over 100 apps like Date Limite, Yuka or FoodVisor.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

🌍 Join Our Mission for Food Transparency



➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.
➜ You can start contributing today by adding a product from your fridge.
➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts


➜ Milk, Gluten, Eggs, Soybeans, Nuts, Fish, Celery, Mustard, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites, Peanuts, Sesame seeds, Crustaceans, Molluscs or Lupin allergy ?
➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.
➜ Be careful that the information may not be 100% accurate, and detection may not be 100% accurate. So always double check by yourself, with the packaging.

💰 Open Prices: Transparency on Food Costs


- Contribute to Price Transparency. When you shop, add the price on the shelf, or at home, add the receipt. Let's track shrinkflation, cheapflation & more.

💄🧴🐶 More Than Just Food: Scan All Your Products


Open Beauty Facts: Scan cosmetics and hygiene products. You can check for ingredients you want to avoid by setting up "ingredient bans" to get personalized alerts.

name: Gluten Dude: GF Restaurants
description:
EATING OUT SHOULDN'T BE THIS HARD.

If you have celiac disease or a gluten intolerance, you've probably done this before.

You find a restaurant that looks promising.

Then the work begins.

You read reviews. You search Facebook groups. You look at crowdsourced apps. You study the menu. You call the restaurant. You hope the person on the phone actually understands what you're asking.

Maybe you feel better.

Maybe you don't.

Either way, you're still left making one of the most important decisions of your day with incomplete information.

That's the part I wanted to fix.

EVERY RESTAURANT EARNS ITS PLACE.

All restaurants start with someone in the gluten-free community who had a safe experience and told us about it.

Then our team gets to work.

First, we research the restaurant — looking into their gluten-free practices and reputation before we ever reach out.

Then we vet it directly. We contact the restaurant and ask the questions that matter. How do they prevent cross-contact? Is there a dedicated fryer? Does the staff understand celiac disease?

Then we write everything up in plain English, so you know what to expect before you ever walk through the door.

Community starting points.

description:

Bei den abwechslungsreichen Rezeptideen ist für jeden Geschmack etwas dabei! Die Vielfalt reicht von Brot und Brötchen über bunte Salate, regionale Klassiker und internationale Spezialitäten bis hin zu köstlichen Kuchen und Torten. Viele Rezepte sind vegetarisch oder vegan. Bei Backrezepten kommen mal fertige und mal eigene Mehlmischungen zum Einsatz.

LASS DICH INSPIRIEREN
Auf der Startseite findest du immer wieder neue Rezeptideen zum Backen und Kochen. Und unser Rezept des Tages bietet dir täglich neue Inspiration. Regelmäßig reinschauen lohnt sich!

GESUCHT, GEFUNDEN!
Du bist auf der Suche nach dem ultimativen Rezept für Pizza oder Zimtschnecken? Oder brauchst du eine Anregung, was du aus dem Kühlschrankinhalt zaubern kannst? Suche nach Stichwörtern oder Zutaten und passe mit dem Suchfilter die Ergebnisse individuell an – lasse dir z. B. nur vegane oder vegetarische Rezepte anzeigen oder schließe Zutaten aus, die du nicht verträgst, wie Ei, Milch oder Hefe. So findest du dein Wunschrezept noch einfacher!

DEINE FAVORITEN ALS KOCHBUCH
Speichere deine Lieblingsrezepte einfach in der App, so hast du dein eigenes Kochbuch immer dabei.

RATGEBER UND ALLTAGSTIPPS
Die Gluten Free App bietet mehr als nur Rezepte: Auf der Startseite findest du immer wieder hilfreiche Artikel rund um den glutenfreien Alltag sowie Hintergrundinfos zu Zöliakie und zur glutenfreien Ernährung.

GLUTEN FREE ALS E-PAPER
Mit dem Gluten Free Plus Abo kannst du alle Ausgaben von Gluten Free als E-Paper lesen. Frischen Lesestoff gibt es alle zwei Monate mit einer neuen Ausgabe des Magazins.

TEST THE BEST
Entdecke und teste die Gluten Free App! Ohne Abo gibt es diese Funktionen kostenfrei für dich:
• Täglich ein neues Rezept des Tages
• 5 Rezepte der immer wieder neuen Rezeptsammlungen auf der Startseite
• Bis zu 5 Favoriten in deinem Kochbuch
• Redaktionelle Beiträge auf der Startseite

GLUTEN FREE PLUS
Du willst das komplette Angebot der Gluten Free App nutzen? Dann profitiere von den Premium-Vorteilen zum kleinen Preis! Mit dem Gluten Free Plus Abo (2,49 € im Monat oder 23,99 € im Jahr) hast du Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und Funktionen:

• Unbegrenzt Lieblingsrezepte in dein Kochbuch speichern
• Alle Ausgaben des Gluten Free Magazins als E-Paper lesen

ÜBER GLUTEN FREE
Im Gluten Free Magazin dreht sich alles rund um die glutenfreie Ernährung. Seit 2017 erscheint das Magazin, inzwischen mit sechs Ausgaben jährlich, in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, in Luxemburg und Südtirol. Seit 2024 gibt es die Rezepte aus dem Gluten Free Magazin auch als App, die wie das Magazin vom frei & fein Verlag herausgegeben wird.

SUPPORT
Du hast eine technische Frage zur App oder ein Problem mit dem Abo? Dann schreibe uns an support@glutenfree-app.de. Wir helfen dir gern weiter!

Viel Spaß beim Kochen und Backen!
Dein Gluten Free Team
